column3: With respect to the Ellenton Premium Outlets Mortgage Loan (3.1%), the related appraisal identified three properties that are primary competitors to the related Mortgaged Property, including Mall at University Town Center, a super-regional mall located approximately 12.5 miles away, and Tampa Premium Outlets, an outlet center located approximately 52.0 miles away, both of which are also owned by the related borrower sponsor.
